title: 实验室危害的类型
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/012_实验室危害的类型.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/012_实验室危害的类型/src.py

points.K3: 危害来自物质、设备和操作
points.K8: 物理危害：火、冷热、锐器、滑倒
points.K15: 危害还会伤环境、伤实验
points.S1: 按危险类别分类分级管理

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验室中央，身后是瓶子、仪器、气瓶
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in the middle of a lab with bottles, instruments and a gas cylinder behind it, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲实验室危害的类型。

shots.scene: 一个圆盘被分成八格，每格一个图标
shots.prompt_en: A round wheel divided into eight slices, each with an icon: a flask, a biohazard symbol, a flame, a gear, a lightning bolt, a radiation trefoil, an ear, and a bent back. No people.
shots.narration: 认清危害，才谈得上防护。

shots.scene: 阿杰第一次来实验室帮忙，环顾四周觉得一切都很平常
shots.prompt_en: The young male student arrives to help in a lab for the first time and looks around casually, relaxed.
shots.narration: 阿杰来帮忙：这屋里哪有危险？

shots.scene: 小研指向墙角的气瓶和地上的一条接线板
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at a gas cylinder in the corner and an extension cord lying on the floor.
shots.narration: 小研指了指气瓶和地上的接线板。

shots.scene: 小研又指向水槽边的一滩水和台面上的碎玻璃
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student then points at a puddle by the sink and a piece of broken glass on the bench.
shots.narration: 还有地上的水、台面的碎玻璃。

shots.scene: 欣欣点头，四周物品依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods while objects around the lab light up one after another.
shots.narration: 危害到处都有，先学会认出来。

shots.scene: 三个图标：健康的人、完好的仪器、一棵绿树，外面一圈盾牌
shots.prompt_en: Three icons inside a shield outline: a healthy person, an intact instrument, and a green tree. No people.
shots.narration: 安全，就是人、财物、环境都不受损害。

shots.scene: 过道里杂乱的纸箱和一块碎玻璃，旁边警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A cluttered aisle with boxes and a sharp piece of broken glass, next to a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 危害，是一切可能造成伤害的东西。

shots.scene: 手指上的创可贴和打了石膏的手臂图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a finger with a bandage and an arm in a plaster cast. No people.
shots.narration: 伤害，是事故落在身上的后果。

shots.scene: 看起来平静的实验台，几个隐藏的危险图标若隐若现
shots.prompt_en: A calm-looking lab bench with faint hidden hazard icons slowly appearing over it. No people.
shots.narration: 危害平时看不见，条件凑齐就出事。

shots.scene: 一滴汽油和一桶汽油并排，两边都有火焰图标
shots.prompt_en: A single drop of fuel next to a large fuel drum, both marked with the same flame icon. No people.
shots.narration: 一滴汽油和一桶汽油，一样易燃。

shots.scene: 危害写在物品身上；风险是一个随条件升降的指针
shots.prompt_en: On the left a flask with a fixed hazard icon; on the right a dial needle that moves up and down. No people.
shots.narration: 危害是物质本身的属性。

shots.scene: 停在车库里的车和在马路上飞驰的车
shots.prompt_en: A car parked quietly in a garage beside the same car speeding on a busy road. No people.
shots.narration: 风险，是被它伤到的可能性。

shots.scene: 可能性乘以后果的图示，两根柱子相乘变高
shots.prompt_en: A diagram with two bars, likelihood and consequence, multiplying into a taller bar. No people.
shots.narration: 可能性越大、后果越重，风险越高。

shots.scene: 通风柜把蒸气挡住，指针下降
shots.prompt_en: A fume hood keeps vapor away from the user and the risk dial needle drops. No people.
shots.narration: 管住接触，就能降低风险。

shots.section_title: 危害来自物质、设备和操作
shots.scene: 一瓶硫酸图标，一边溶解金属，一边皮肤灼伤图标
shots.prompt_en: A sulfuric acid bottle icon: on one side it dissolves a metal piece, on the other side a skin burn icon. No people.
shots.narration: 让化学品有用的性质，恰恰也是危害。
overlay: 危害来自物质、设备和操作

shots.section_title: 危害来自物质、设备和操作
shots.scene: 腐蚀、毒性、易燃、反应性四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: corrosion, toxicity, flammability and reactivity. No people.
shots.narration: 腐蚀、有毒、易燃、活泼，都是危害。

shots.section_title: 危害来自物质、设备和操作
shots.scene: 加热板上的烧瓶和旁边的溶剂瓶，警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A flask on a hot plate with a solvent bottle nearby, and a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 操作也有危害：加热时，热源就是危险。

shots.section_title: 危害来自物质、设备和操作
shots.scene: 合成流程：混合、加热搅拌、沉淀、过滤四个图标
shots.prompt_en: A process strip of four icons: mixing, heating with stirring, precipitation, and filtration. No people.
shots.narration: 每一步操作，都要想有什么危害。

shots.scene: 放大镜在实验流程图上逐步扫过
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass moves step by step across a blank experiment flowchart. No people.
shots.narration: 识别危害，是一切防护的第一步。

shots.scene: 一个没被发现的危险图标躲在阴影里，被打叉的盾牌
shots.prompt_en: A hazard icon hiding in a shadow next to a broken shield, crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 没找出来的危险，根本没法控制。

shots.scene: 一半明显的危险（地上的水），一半藏着的危险（无色气体）
shots.prompt_en: Split image: an obvious puddle on the floor and an invisible colorless gas shown as a faint outline. No people.
shots.narration: 有的一眼可见，有的藏得很深。

shots.scene: 阿杰停下手，站在实验台前思考
shots.prompt_en: The young male student pauses with hands off the bench, thinking before starting.
shots.narration: 动手之前，先停一下想清楚。

shots.scene: 八格圆盘转动，每格亮起
shots.prompt_en: The eight-slice hazard wheel rotates and each slice lights up in turn. No people.
shots.narration: 按来源，危害可以分成几大类。

shots.scene: 化学、生物、物理三个大图标
shots.prompt_en: Three large icons: a flask, a biohazard symbol and a flame. No people.
shots.narration: 化学、生物、物理，最常见。

shots.scene: 设备、电气、辐射、噪声、工效五个图标
shots.prompt_en: Five icons: a gear, a lightning bolt, a radiation trefoil, an ear, and a person bending at a desk. No people.
shots.narration: 还有设备、电、辐射、噪声和工效。

shots.scene: 化学品分类的三格：火焰、骷髅人形、枯树和鱼
shots.prompt_en: Three boxes: a flame for physical hazards, a human silhouette for health hazards, and a dead tree with a fish for environmental hazards. No people.
shots.narration: 化学品又分物理、健康、环境危害。

shots.scene: 生物实验室里同时有化学瓶、电线和灭火器
shots.prompt_en: A biology lab bench that also holds chemical bottles, electrical cords and a fire extinguisher nearby. No people.
shots.narration: 一间实验室，往往多种危害并存。

shots.scene: 台面上的酸、碱、溶剂瓶和一盒粉末
shots.prompt_en: Acid, base and solvent bottles and a box of fine powder on a lab bench. No people.
shots.narration: 酸、碱、溶剂、粉末，都是化学危害。

shots.scene: 眼睛、皮肤、肺三个人体部位图标，红色警示
shots.prompt_en: Three body icons, an eye, a hand's skin and a pair of lungs, each with a red warning mark. No people.
shots.narration: 会灼伤皮肤，伤眼睛，伤呼吸道。

shots.scene: 一瓶倾倒的瓶子，液体流出，旁边起火的图标
shots.prompt_en: A tipped bottle with liquid spreading, and a small flame icon nearby. No people.
shots.narration: 洒漏、泄漏、着火，就在一瞬间。

shots.scene: 胶水、涂料和粉尘图标，被一只放大镜照着
shots.prompt_en: Icons of glue, paint and dust under a magnifying glass. No people.
shots.narration: 胶水、涂料、粉尘，不起眼也伤人。

shots.scene: 细菌、病毒、毒素图标漂浮在培养皿上方
shots.prompt_en: Bacteria, virus and toxin icons float above a petri dish, beside a biohazard warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 细菌、病毒和毒素，可能让人感染。

shots.scene: 血样管、实验小鼠、植物和带标记的菌株管
shots.prompt_en: A blood sample tube, a lab mouse, a potted plant and a marked microbial strain tube. No people.
shots.narration: 血液、动物、植物、改造菌株也算。

shots.scene: 看不见的微小颗粒从台面扩散开
shots.prompt_en: Tiny invisible particles drawn as faint dots spreading out from a bench surface. No people.
shots.narration: 看不见摸不着，一不小心就扩散。

shots.section_title: 物理危害：火、冷热、锐器、滑倒
shots.scene: 火焰、爆炸、碎玻璃、湿滑地面四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a flame, an explosion burst, broken glass and a wet floor sign. No people.
shots.narration: 火、爆炸、割伤、滑倒，都是物理危害。
overlay: 物理危害：火、冷热、锐器、滑倒

shots.section_title: 物理危害：火、冷热、锐器、滑倒
shots.scene: 高温炉发出红光，旁边一罐冒白气的液氮
shots.prompt_en: A glowing high-temperature furnace next to a dewar of liquid nitrogen giving off white vapor. No people.
shots.narration: 高温会烫伤，低温液体会冻伤。

shots.section_title: 物理危害：火、冷热、锐器、滑倒
shots.scene: 水槽、碎玻璃、酒精灯火焰和工具，各自一个提醒图标
shots.prompt_en: A sink, broken glassware, a burner flame and a hand tool, each with a small caution icon. No people.
shots.narration: 水、玻璃、明火、工具，天天都在身边。

shots.section_title: 物理危害：火、冷热、锐器、滑倒
shots.scene: 地上的水旁边一个摔倒的小人图标
shots.prompt_en: A puddle on the floor next to a slipping stick figure pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 越常见，越容易被忽视。

shots.section_title: 物理危害：火、冷热、锐器、滑倒
shots.scene: 【实拍】湿滑地面警示牌放在拖过的地面上（本校现场，无人）
shots.prompt_en: A yellow wet floor caution sign standing on a freshly mopped lab floor. No people.
shots.narration: 看到湿滑提示，绕开慢行。

shots.scene: 离心机转子高速旋转，一侧样品管多了一支，警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A centrifuge rotor spinning fast with one extra tube on one side, and a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 离心机像飞轮，不平衡会出大事。

shots.scene: 墙边的高压气瓶
shots.prompt_en: A tall compressed gas cylinder standing against a lab wall, with a pressure gauge icon. No people.
shots.narration: 气瓶里是高压气体，同样是危害。

shots.scene: 转动的皮带轮和飞出的碎屑图标
shots.prompt_en: A rotating belt pulley and flying debris icons. No people.
shots.narration: 转动部件、飞溅物，也会伤人。

shots.scene: 没培训过的设备旁边一个停止手势
shots.prompt_en: An unfamiliar instrument with a stop hand icon in front of it. No people.
shots.narration: 设备用错或故障，都会出事。

shots.scene: 照明、风扇、温控仪和仪器都连着电线
shots.prompt_en: Lights, a fan, a temperature controller and instruments all connected by power cords. No people.
shots.narration: 哪个实验室都离不开电。

shots.scene: 老化开裂的电线冒出火花
shots.prompt_en: An old cracked power cord giving off a small spark. No people.
shots.narration: 电线老化、设备失修，会触电起火。

shots.scene: 水槽旁乱拉的接线板被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An extension cord stretched across a wet sink area, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 水源旁边，不能乱拉电线。

shots.scene: 电离辐射警告标志和一个放射源容器
shots.prompt_en: An ionizing radiation warning sign next to a sealed lead container. No people.
shots.narration: 放射性物质，照射和污染都伤人。

shots.scene: 激光、紫外灯、微波三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a laser beam, an ultraviolet lamp and a microwave wave symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 激光、紫外等非电离辐射也有危害。

shots.scene: 放射源保险柜上锁，旁边培训证书图标
shots.prompt_en: A locked storage safe for radioactive sources next to a training certificate icon. No people.
shots.narration: 放射源严格保管，须经专门培训。

shots.scene: 一台轰鸣的设备，声波一圈圈扩散，耳朵图标
shots.prompt_en: A loud machine with sound waves spreading out in circles and an ear icon. No people.
shots.narration: 长期噪声大，会损伤听力。

shots.scene: 警报铃在响，但声波被噪声盖住
shots.prompt_en: An alarm bell rings but its sound waves are drowned out by louder machine noise. No people.
shots.narration: 还会听不清提醒，耽误应急。

shots.scene: 小研长时间弯腰在实验台前，颈肩腰亮红
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student bends over a lab bench for a long time; her neck, shoulders and lower back glow red.
shots.narration: 长时间弯腰、动作总重复，会劳损。

shots.scene: 小研调高椅子，起身活动
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student adjusts her chair height and stands up to stretch.
shots.narration: 调好桌椅高度，定时起身活动。

shots.scene: 疲惫的人和一团乱线的头脑图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a tired person with a tangled scribble over the head. No people.
shots.narration: 压力和疲劳，属于心理危害。

shots.scene: 阿杰站在实验台前，各类危害图标都指向他
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands at a bench while hazard icons all point toward him.
shots.narration: 危害最终会落到做实验的人身上。

shots.scene: 咳嗽、皮肤发红、过敏三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a coughing face, reddened skin and an allergy rash. No people.
shots.narration: 轻的呛咳、皮肤发红，或者过敏。

shots.scene: 急性中毒和感染两个更严重的图标
shots.prompt_en: Two more serious icons: acute poisoning and infection, in dark red. No people.
shots.narration: 重的会急性中毒，或被感染。

shots.scene: 针头、碎玻璃、绊倒的小人和骨折图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a needle, broken glass, a tripping stick figure and a bone fracture. No people.
shots.narration: 锐器、绊倒，小到割伤，大到骨折。

shots.section_title: 危害还会伤环境、伤实验
shots.scene: 实验室外的下水道和空气被污染的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons outside a lab building: a polluted drain and a hazy polluted sky. No people.
shots.narration: 危害还会伤到实验室外的环境。
overlay: 危害还会伤环境、伤实验

shots.section_title: 危害还会伤环境、伤实验
shots.scene: 被污染的培养皿和一份作废的实验记录
shots.prompt_en: A contaminated petri dish next to a blank lab record crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 样品污染了，实验也就白做了。

shots.section_title: 按危险类别分类分级管理
shots.scene: 学校、学院、实验室三层图标上，各实验室挂不同危险类别牌
shots.prompt_en: A three-level chart of university, department and labs, with each lab door showing a different hazard category icon. No people.
shots.narration: 高校按危险类别，对实验室分类分级管理。
overlay: 按危险类别分类分级管理

shots.section_title: 按危险类别分类分级管理
shots.scene: 【实拍】实验室门口安全信息牌特写：危险类别标识和负责人栏（本校现场或样张，遮挡姓名电话）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a lab door safety information board with hazard category icons and a blank contact panel. No people.
shots.narration: 门口信息牌，写明这里有哪类危害。

shots.section_title: 按危险类别分类分级管理
shots.scene: 阿杰站在门口看信息牌，点头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stops at a lab door, reads the blank safety information board and nods.
shots.narration: 进门前，先看清本室的危险类别。

shots.scene: 安全、危害、风险三个图标连成一线
shots.prompt_en: Three linked icons: a shield, a warning triangle and a risk dial. No people.
shots.narration: 危害是属性，风险看可能性和后果。

shots.scene: 八格圆盘
shots.prompt_en: The eight-slice hazard wheel. No people.
shots.narration: 化学、生物、物理、设备、电、辐射……

shots.scene: 人、环境、实验三个图标被盾牌护住
shots.prompt_en: A shield protecting three icons: a person, the environment and an experiment flask. No people.
shots.narration: 先认出危害，再去评估和控制。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一本空白手册挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank safety handbook and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课，讲安全信息从哪里查。
